data.name: Vishvas
data.gender_notes: Vishvas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has faith or belief in the divine or the universe. The name Vishvas carries the meaning “Faith, Belief” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Vishvas usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is expected to grow up with faith and trust in the divine or the universe
data.etymology: Vishvas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishvas total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vishvas is deeply rooted in the Hindu tradition, where faith, belief, and trust play a significant role in the spiritual journey of an individual. data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Vishvas represents an inner quality that allows an individual to trust in the divine plan of the universe. It is a name that encourages faith, devotion, and the belief that the universe will provide for one's needs. Vishvas is also a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the importance of trusting in the power of the universe to guide one's life.
